name: 68520 · Lincoln, NE
findings: ZIP 68520 (Lincoln) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68520 (Lincoln) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68520 (Lincoln) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 10% of all organizations here have no identified type.
